headline: Five-party agreement to establish a business zone for technology companies "Tafila Technical Square" within Tafila Technical University
summary: The Ministry of Labor, Tafila Technical University and the ICT association Intaj agreed to establish a technology business zone. The plan aims to attract about five companies and employ about 20 graduates.
why: Technology business zones at universities are local initiatives that support job creation and digital sector growth in regional economies like Jordan's.
